reported_comment.text: People like you always ruin this group. Nobody wants you here.

context.earlier_exchange: Lena posted a harsh critique of Dario's photos 3 days ago, and Dario replied twice in an annoyed tone before this comment; Lena then replied with a sarcastic remark.

state.moderator_note: Check with a senior before suspending anyone. Context file incomplete.

constraints.statement: Treat a mutual heated exchange as mitigating context when picking a penalty.
Suspend an account on a single report alone.
Prefer the lowest penalty that stops the behaviour.

reference_facts.name: warning_window
reference_facts.value: Only warnings from the last 90 days count toward escalation

reference_facts.name: third_warning_penalty
reference_facts.value: A third counted warning leads to a 3-day suspension

criteria.true: The comment is hostile language aimed at one specific person.
criteria.false: The comment is general criticism that is not aimed at one specific person.

penalty.instructions: Choose the penalty for the comment's author.

criteria.no_action: Take no action and leave the comment up.
criteria.remove_comment_only: Take the comment down with no penalty to the author.
criteria.private_warning: Send the author a private warning and keep a record.
criteria.public_warning_note: Add a visible moderator note on the thread.
criteria.mute_in_thread_24h: Stop the author from posting in this thread for 24 hours.
criteria.three_day_suspension: Suspend the account for three days.
criteria.refer_to_senior_moderator: Pass the case to a senior moderator.

harassment_severity.instructions: Rate how severe the harassment is, taking the context into account.
